Maya: FYI nightly eval alerted on the 'constrained-summaries' promptset — big quality drop after we started the bitwidth sweep (int8 -> 4-bit mix). baseline fp16 rouge-l 0.82 -> post-sweep 0.67. run id run_2026_03_18_23:11
Oliver: link to the job? can you paste the eval command + model + precision config? :eyes:
Maya: command below, output snippet attached. reproducer: `python -m rdx_eval.run --suite constrained-summaries --model rdx-llama3-13b --precision mixed-int8-4bit --quant-profile sweep-2026-03 --seed 42 --save-outputs /tmp/run_123`
Maya: ```
2026-03-18 23:14:03 INFO eval: loading model rdx-llama3-13b (mixed-int8-4bit)
2026-03-18 23:14:12 WARN quant: layer 22 scale negative clamp applied
2026-03-18 23:15:30 METRIC rouge_l 0.671
```
Sasha: interesting — the logs show a layer clamp. my bet is the 4-bit path is using symmetric per-tensor scales while the int8 path used per-channel asymmetric. that mismatch can wreck LM head logits. did we run post-quant calibration for the 4-bit variants?
Jamie: I scanned the layerwise diffs from the nightly dump — layernorms 20-24 spike in activation kurtosis after quant. quick table: `layer 20 +3.2`, `21 +4.7`, `22 +9.1` (compared to int8 baseline).
Kevin: can someone drop the minimal reproducer for me to run locally? i'll try with `--calib-steps 512` and with `--per-channel True` to see if it moves. also what HW was used for that night? could be kernel fallback using older CUDA kernels.
Maya: nightly used g4x-reserved pool (dedicated). job meta: gpu_type=A100-80GB, cuda 12.2, triton 2.33. i already kicked off a repro with `--calib-dataset short` + `--per-channel True`, job id repro_778.
Oliver: if per-channel fixes it we should update the quant profile, but we need to understand why sweep flipped defaults. iirc the sweep script toggles `use_per_channel` when bitwidth <=4 to use symmetric quant — looks like a bug in the sweep YAML.
Sasha: yep, saw that line in the sweep generator: `use_per_channel: ${bitwidth > 4}` (should be `>=`). so 4-bit ended up with per-tensor symmetric. need PR to generator. i'll open one.
Jamie: until fixed we should pin the routing policy for production model to `profile: int8-default` — Nora, can you help with a temporary routing override?
Nora: on it. i'll add a fallback route for rdx-llama3-13b that prefers `int8-default` for hosted and dedicated for the next 24h, then we can re-evaluate after repro results. :thumbsup:
Kevin: repro_778 logs look promising — calibration + per-channel brings rouge-l to 0.80 locally. i'll push the trimmed debug trace to S3 and post link in the ticket.
Maya: nice. can we also run eval with `--disable-4bit-path` to confirm it's the 4-bit codepath and not an unrelated change?
Oliver: good call. i'll add that to the CI matrix for the next nightly: three legs (fp16 baseline, int8 profile, int8+4bit).
eng-ci-bot: nightly-evals job 2026-03-19T01:00:00Z reported 1 failing suite (constrained-summaries). created ticket INF-4521.
Sasha: created PR #3145 to fix sweep generator default. requesting review from infra and eng-ml.
Maya: thanks all. plan: (1) pin routing -> Nora done, (2) land PR to generator, (3) merge per-channel calibration into quant profiles, (4) re-run nightly with matrix. i'll update INF-4521 with repro artifacts. :white_check_mark:
